_comment: Copy to %LOCALAPPDATA%\AI Usage Native\config\projects.json (Claude Code) or codex-projects.json (Codex). A project id is its working folder with the separators and punctuation turned into '-': C:\Users\you\Projects\old-name becomes C--Users-you-Projects-old-name. Keys starting with _ are ignored. The Projects page's Rename... and Merge into... do the same without editing this file.

merge._comment: Count the first project as part of the second, e.g. a folder that was renamed or moved.

displayNames._comment: Show a project under this name instead of its folder's.
